newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: W. Australia moving ahead on Ord agriculture plan.
newsitem.headline: W. Australia moving ahead on Ord agriculture plan.

text.p: The Western Australian government has appointed Western Agricultural Industries Pty Ltd (WAI) to begin a feasibility study into the potential for irrigated agriculture in the West Kimberley region of the northwest of the state.

The company, a joint-venture between Kimberley Agricultural Industries Pty Ltd and Queensland Cotton Holdings Ltd, will conduct a comprehensive study to further a conceptual study finalised by the Kimberley Water Resources Development Office in 1993.
That study identified potential for the development of agriculture and freshwater aquaculture in the region, Primary Industry Minister Monty House said in a statement.
The revitalised Ord River irrigation project, in the state's Kimberley region, is headed toward producing its first cotton crop in November/December 1997.
